title: SOAR: Social and Opinion-Aware Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2610.29556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: One of the enduring challenges in online platforms is recommendation. Both communities and advertisers face difficulties in analyzing complex user behavior, identifying habits and evolving preferences, and providing timely recommendations that are relevant to user interests. In particular, point of interest recommendation poses the additional challenge of identifying the factors that influence user behavior, capturing user tendencies, and generating accurate, personalized recommendations for each individual. In this work, we propose SOAR, a Social and Opinion Aware Recommendation model that incorporates both the user's friendship network and textual reviews to assess whether a location is suitable for a specific user, with a particular emphasis on the sentiment of shared reviews. Experimental results in real-world datasets demonstrate that incorporating reviews into the recommendation process improves the precision of the recommendation.

translated_title: SOAR：社交与观点感知的推荐系统
translated_abstract: 在线平台面临的一个持久挑战是推荐问题。无论是社区还是广告商，在分析复杂的用户行为、识别用户习惯和不断变化的偏好，以及提供与用户兴趣相关的及时推荐方面都存在困难。特别是兴趣点推荐还面临额外的挑战：识别影响用户行为的因素、捕捉用户倾向，并为每个个体生成准确、个性化的推荐。在本工作中，我们提出了SOAR，一个社交与观点感知的推荐模型，该模型结合了用户的社交好友网络和文本评论来评估某个地点是否适合特定用户，并特别关注共享评论中的情感信息。在真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，将评论纳入推荐过程能够提高推荐的精确度。
tldr: 提出了SOAR推荐模型，通过结合用户社交好友网络与文本评论的情感信息，实现更精准的个性化兴趣点推荐。
en_tdlr: SOAR is a social and opinion-aware recommendation model that leverages users' friendship networks and the sentiment of textual reviews to deliver more precise and personalized point-of-interest recommendations.
